nodes.label: Web Splash Screen Dark Mode 2x (AshaSathi Logo)
nodes.description: Web splash screen image for dark mode at 2x pixel density (Retina/HiDPI). Identical design to dark-1x.png but at double resolution for sharp display on high-DPI screens. AshaSathi brand logo: bold green 'ASHA SATHI' stacked text with integrated house icon in matching green on white background.
